Air does not come from nowhere: the Air Compressor checks no recipes and just keeps the beat — trading steam for air, pumping the network one stroke at a time, blunt and honest.

It carries its own safety net: when tank pressure runs short it falls back to the lower air tier automatically — §3the line never stalls§r. Bigger tanks mean steadier buffering; parallel for speed, pace for thrift — the numbers live in the tooltip.

§8§oThe wind is free; the pump is not.§r
